reasons: Claimed status is compliant with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output; the cited paragraphs support that classification.

p0017 vests all Works (deliverables under each SOW) in Company with perfection assistance, so there is no assignment of Customer IP or data to Contractor and no joint ownership; p0020 only preserves Contractor's pre-existing tools/know-how, which the rule expressly permits.

p0021 supplies the required licence-back for Contractor's Information embedded in the Works (royalty-free, perpetual, sublicensable, right to modify and create derivatives), and p0022 confirms Company may modify the software itself or via third parties without further payment — meeting the preferred position on material terms.

The rationale correctly treats the missing 'irrevocable'/'worldwide' wording, the payment-conditioned ownership trigger, and the absence of an express Customer Data ownership sentence (data is covered as Confidential Information) as minor sub-elements noted rather than redlined, consistent with the classification rules.
Deterministic check (no assignment of Customer Data/IP to Vendor) passes and no unnecessary edits were introduced.
